items.title: 🎯 Reject JWTs with Out-of-Bounds Expiration (`exp`) Values to Prevent `time.Time` Overflow
items.body_head: ## 📝 Description JWTs containing extremely large `exp` (Expiration Time) values currently trigger inconsistent behavior during claims validation. Depending on the platform and how the numeric value is parsed (e.g., as a `float64` from JSON or cast to an integer), the parser may overflow, wrap around, or treat the token as effectively non-expiring.
